title: fumaria bulbosa subsp. intermedia
intro: Fumaria bulbosa subsp. intermedia, commonly known as intermediate fumitory, is a plant species within the Fumaria genus, which is a group of annual or biennial flowering plants in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The health benefits of Fumaria bulbosa subsp. intermedia include reducing inflammation and alleviating nausea, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiemetic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
